# Any Fielder Receives

## Statement

Any fielder can receive a pass at any time — open play stays responsive; no fielder is structurally locked out of participation.

## Who Feels It

The player directing plays; AI fielders acting autonomously. Restricted receivers make practices feel scripted.

## Evidence

Grill decision: open-play model chosen over scripted receiver chains for practice realism.
